name: Fantasy Football GM (Christopher)
tagline: Runs the weekly fantasy football checklist for Yahoo, ESPN and Sleeper leagues
description: Set up your Yahoo, ESPN or Sleeper league and it takes over the weekly routine: lineup calls for each slot, waiver targets worth a bid, and the matchup context behind them. Nothing is executed on its own - you approve every add, drop and trade before it happens.
author: Christopher
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
